articleTitle: Development of Method of Protection of Solar Panels Against Dust Pollution in the Northern Part of the Russian Far East
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper is devoted to research about the method of protection against dust pollution of the surface of a polycrystalline solar panel of small power in the northern part of the Russian far east (the territory of the North), where the article presents graphical interpretations of power generation depending on dust content parameters and calculation of changes in electric power generation parameters. The purpose of this paper is to find an effective method for protecting the surface of a polycrystalline solar panel of small power from dust pollution. The result of this article is the calculation and derivation of solar panel generation indicators with the presentation of graphical interpretations of power dependence on monitoring time. In addition, based on the calculated comparison of solar panel generation using various chemical liquid coatings, the article presents a specific type of chemical material that protects the surface of the solar panel from dust pollution and reduces the effect of adhesion properties on the period up to 15 days. Thus, the above-mentioned method of protecting the surface of the solar panel from dust pollution can be applied in research institutes and generating enterprises in order to increase energy efficiency and generate electricity in solar power plants in the northern part of the Russian Far East.

articleTitle: Neural Network for Real-Time Signal Processing: the Nonlinear Distortions Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Artificial neural networks, after their training and testing, allow, in the "if then" mode, to process signals in real time. This is relevant for signal processing tasks in electrical engineering and the electric power industry, especially for the analysis of nonlinear signal distortions, transients in electrical networks, during switching, emergency modes, and so on. The paper shows the neuro algorithm possibilities based on an elementary perceptron for filtering nonlinear distortions of industrial frequency signals of 50 Hz over a time interval of units of milliseconds. At the same time, the accuracy for the signals’ amplitude, phase, and frequency determining is units of percent. Examples of the fundamental frequency signal selection in the presence of harmonics, the determination of the signal parameters during transients, and the correction of the transformer saturation current are given. It is shown that real-time neural network processing can be carried out in a "sliding window" with the duration of units of milliseconds. The estimates made during the implementation of the neuro algorithm in a microprocessor device showed its application possibility in the electric power industry secondary equipment.

articleTitle: Integrated LC-Components for Electrical Systems and Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The technical disadvantages of electrical systems and devices include the large mass and large dimensions of its constituent electromagnetic elements. The usual way to eliminate these technical disadvantages is the frequency increasing. In this paper, the authors consider a different effective way to reduce weight and size. This way is the functional integration of electromagnetic elements (EME) in the converter and power electronics. The integrated EMEs perform several functions, such as transformation, stabilization, filtration, protection, etc. The performed analysis of hybrid EME confirms the feasibility and efficiency of their application in various electrical converters. The paper proposes a classification of electrical devices based on integrated LC-component. An example of useful applications of integrated LC-component is induction heating devices sold to the oil and gas industry.

articleTitle: Neuro Algorithm Accuracy Evaluation for The Anomalies Detecting in Overcurrent Protection Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: To control information exchange in the digital substation, it is possible to use machine learning methods, the artificial neural networks (ANN), in particular. The ANN training, as a multifactor optimization problem, and its testing make it possible to detect anomalies in information flows and operating modes of the secondary equipment in electric power industries. Using examples for neuro-modeling of overcurrent protection operation mode in a three-phase network, the paper shows the features of a neural network functioning based on an elementary perceptron and estimates the accuracy of the corresponding models. The structure of the simplest neural network is optimized and accuracy evaluation of the neural network algorithm is presented depending on the training sample volume (from 1000 to 50000 records) and the number of training epochs. It was found that neuromodelling makes it possible to evaluate with a high accuracy the value for overcurrent protection adequate trip setting. The deviation range of current values in each phase, when the neural network makes errors in data recognition, does not exceed one percent of the threshold value., The neural network in this range is very "sensitive" to changes in input signals. It is shown that if emergency modes with adequate actuation of relay protection are considered as standard secondary equipment operation modes, then neuromodeling and corresponding signal processing make it possible to detect anomalies in the standard secondary equipment operation modes in the electric power system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Indirect Methods for Determining the Isolation Parameters of the Network Phases Relative to the Ground on a Computer Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article highlights the current problem of choosing methods for monitoring the insulation of quarry distribution networks. The article is devoted to the study of the parameters of the isolation of the network phases relative to the ground of quarry distribution electric networks. The evaluation of a method based on connecting an additional capacitance to one of the phases for determining the parameters of phase isolation relative to the ground of networks with an isolated neutral voltage of 6 kV in the MATLAB/SIMULINK software environment is considered. The results of the analysis of the influence of various factors on the accuracy of measurements of the active and reactive components of the total insulation resistance of the network phases relative to the ground are presented. Connecting additional capacity does not lead, in practice, to overvoltage in the network, does not create a dangerous situation for personnel, and the data obtained in this case coincides well with the actual values.

Author Keywords: network phase isolation parameters relative to the ground

articleTitle: Development of a Method for Location of a Damaged Overhead Power Line Section in Case of Single-Phase Earth Faults
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Single-phase earth faults (SPEFs) are the predominant type of damage in medium voltage networks and the root cause of accidents with significant economic damage. Damage location (location of damaged power line section) in the case of SPEF on an overhead power line (OPL) allows not only to reduce the time for SPEF location, but also to prevent the transition of the SPEF into a double earth fault. The article is devoted to the development of a method for location of the damaged OPL section using digital measuring transformers as primary converters. The proposed method is based on the measurement of electrical values at SPEF on the buses of the substation and at the sending ends of the OPL branches. The method is implemented in a prototype of 6 (10) kV automated power control and metering station (APCMS).

articleTitle: Study of the 34,5 kV Network Voltage Quality During the Parallel Operation of an Electric Arc Furnace and Rolling Mill Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work carried out research on the frequency response of the 34.5 kV network of the metallurgical plant "MMK Metalurji", Iskenderun, Turkey during the parallel operation of the rolling and electric steel-making complexes. A comprehensive simulation model of an arc steelmaking furnace, electric drives of a rolling mill and an in-plant network of 34,5 kV has been developed. In the simulation, the experimentally obtained instantaneous values of the currents consumed by the equipment of the electric steel-making and rolling complexes were used. The results of modeling the frequency response of a 34,5 kV network with parallel operation of two complexes were presented. The problem of the influence of resonance phenomena in the frequency response of the 34,5 kV network on the voltage quality during the parallel operation of the electric steel-making and rolling complexes was revealed. A method was proposed for shifting the resonance to the safe region of the frequency response, where there are no significant harmonics generated by active rectifiers. Thanks to the application of this method, an improvement in the harmonic composition of the voltage across the 34,5 kV busbar section is achieved.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of a PI Speed Controller for a Separately Excited DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The study is devoted to the mathematical simulation of a PI controller-based DC motor speed control system. DC motors are widely used in the industry to drive cyclic mechanisms requiring high response speed and starting torque, and linear control. The main methods to control the required separately excited DC motor speed characteristics comprise controlling the parameters of the armature and excitation windings powered from different sources. PI controllers are widely used in programmable logic controllers due to the simplicity and clarity of the mathematical tools. The PI controller mathematical model proposed is based on choosing optimal parameters to maintain the actual speed close to the set value. The optimal KP and KI coefficients of the PI controller have been determined, giving the best result for constant speed. The results of computer simulation in MatLab have been compared with that of the laboratory simulation. The data obtained based on the steady-state error and transient time using a PI controller look preferable to the voltage control simulation model. The developed mathematical model has shown the following key results: acceleration time <0.3 s; transient time <0.5 s; overshoot and steady-state error do not exceed 0.5 and 0.1 %, respectively.

articleTitle: A Robust Methodology Approach Based Sparrow Search Algorithm for the Incorporation of Rdgs to Improve the Distribution Grid Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The growth tendency in power demands increases the problems of electrical distribution networks like high system losses, voltage levels degradation, and other parameters. The most suitable solution technically and environmentally is the Renewable Distributed Generators (RDGs). This paper represents a robust methodology approach based Sparrow Search Algorithm (SPSA) to assure the optimum allocation of RDGs in the distribution network under different power factor unity, 0.95, and optimum values. Comprehensive analysis with different modern optimization techniques in different cases has been implemented to validate the performance of the SPSA technique. The proposed SPSA is applied to the IEEE 69-bus distribution system. The numerical results investigated that the SPSA technique has high quality to enhance the voltage levels and minify the system power losses as compared with the other modern techniques. The MATLAB environment is used to execute the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Speed Coordination System for Electric Drives of a Plate Mill Stand: Theory and Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper briefly analyzes the technology behind the upward bending of the frontend of the strip leaving the reversing stand of a plate mill. It emphasizes the importance of more precise speed coordination of motors driving the horizontal rolls. The paper further presents the results of testing a variety of speed and load parameters. It concludes that the upper roll and the lower roll differ significantly in motor torque. This difference is attributable to the significant dynamic deviations in speed that are observed when the rolls nip the metal strip, and to the fact that the load distribution controller (LDC) is slow. The paper showcases the author-developed method for motor speed coordination during frontend bending. It proposes a control system featuring a switching structure. The paper further shows the structure of a model that simulates connected roll drives. Simulations prove more precise speed control during frontend bending. This finding has been confirmed by experimentation. The method has been implemented as an algorithm on Mill 5000. The paper concludes with recommendations on its adoption in plate mills.

articleTitle: New Implementation of Common-Mode-Voltage-Eliminating Nearest-Vector-Selecting Space Vector Control for Three-Phase Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A simpler implementation of the space vector control technique, which is selecting the vectors nearest to the reference, and whereby providing elimination of the common-mode voltage of three-phase multilevel voltage source inverters (MLVSI) is proposed. The considered algorithm applies the particular MLVSI voltage space vectors, which produce the zero value of the common-mode voltage, i.e. the voltage across the load common point and the MLVSI common point. Two normalized inverter phase voltages values (star load voltages) have been projected to the new oblique-angled 60-degree axes. These values are treated not only as the oblique-angled coordinates, but also as barycentric coordinates on triangles of three nearest zero-common-mode-voltage vectors. The offered approach helps to get rid of the drawback of the conventional implementation of the space vector control with elimination of the common-mode voltage. In particular, no multiple applying per sampling period the square function and the square root function, related to distances calculations, are needed.

Author Keywords: integer and fractional parts of voltages normalized values

articleTitle: Experience of Using Bluetooth Low Energy to Develop a Sensor Data Exchange System Based on the NRF52832 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A brief overview of Bluetooth Low Energy technology is presented: API and built-in data exchange toolkit are considered. The main capabilities of the Bluetooth 5.2 version and the validity of its use in industrial wireless data transmission systems are shown. The idea of creating wireless monitoring systems based on the NRF52832 microcontroller is presented. The technology makes it possible to conveniently implement a data exchange system and includes the necessary tools for its implementation - packet integrity check (CRC), packet delivery check (response), data encryption, automatic retrieval of up-todate data. The experience of development in the Segger Embedded Studio and Xcode environments is shown. The server and client parts of the project have been implemented. Data exchange between devices has been carried out. Considered a development tools for server and client devices. Also in this article, a comparison is made with competing technologies such as ZigBee. In addition, possible industrial applications of the technology were considered.

articleTitle: The Adaptive Current Protection of Electric Motors at a Digital Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: To protect high-voltage electric motors (EM) from phase-to-phase short circuits, current cut-offs are widely used. The current cut-offs main disadvantage is the low sensitivity due to the tripping current fixed value. The current cut-offs sensitivity can be increased by giving it adaptive properties. To perform adaptive protection, it is necessary to exchange information between intelligent devices of different cells: EM cells, input switch cells and voltage transformer cells. At a classical substation, the organization of such an exchange of information leads to a complication of secondary circuits and a loss of the transmitted data accuracy. Therefore the implementation of adaptive protection became a reality only with the advent of digital substations. The article considers the change in working conditions, the scheme and properties of adaptive protection at a digital substation. In the adaptive current cut-off the tripping current is adjusted from the inrush current that would have been when the EM was started in the current network mode and which is determined by the measured bus voltage and input current in real time. At the same time, the main feature of adaptive protection is that both the tripping current and the sensitivity coefficient are determined at the same parameters of the electrical network. A mathematical model of the network, current cut-off and electric motor has been developed for the study of adaptive protection. The current cutoff efficiency was estimated by the protected zone length at internal short circuits in the stator winding.

articleTitle: Economic Efficiency of Solar and Wind Energy Joint Use in Autonomous Power Supply Systems on Lake Baikal Coast
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Economic efficiency assessment of an autonomous power supply system with renewable energy sources on Lake Baikal coast has been carried out. The system includes photovoltaic converters, wind turbines, storage batteries and a diesel power plant. The optimal modes of operation of the system elements and its structure have been determined. For this purpose, a mathematical model is used that minimizes the total discounted costs while meeting a number of constraints. Climatic and meteorological data correspond to the conditions of the areas of the Lake Baikal coast in the Irkutsk region, not connected to a centralized power supply. The energy generated by renewable energy sources has been determined. The calculation results showed that the joint use of solar and wind energy increases the economic efficiency of the power system: the rejection of one of these energy sources increases costs.

articleTitle: Weighted THD Factors Evaluation of Multilevel Voltage Source Inverter with Space Vector Control under Common-Mode Voltage Elimination
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The harmonic distortion’s characteristics of the nearest-vector-selecting space vector control with common-mode voltage eliminating technique (CMVE-SVC) for three-phase multilevel voltage source inverter (MLVSI) are explored. The considered CMVE-SVC algorithm applies the particular MLVSI voltage space vectors, which produce the zero value of the common-mode voltage, i.e. the voltage across the load common point and the MLVSI common point. More specifically, the THD of the output phase voltage along with three its weighted THD of low orders are calculated in a virtual instrument of LabVIEW. The simulated dependences on the index of the amplitude modulation of the phase voltage are compared with the dependences of a recently proposed common-mode-voltage-eliminating space vector pulse width modulation technique. The importance of the considered weighted THDs for the load current THD assessment is noted.

articleTitle: Compression of the Training Sample of the Smart Protection Device without Compromising its Information Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In the algorithms of their functioning, Smart Protection Devices use machine learning methods that provide them with the ability to make decisions in the multidimensional space of parameters controlled by the device. To make the Smart Protection Device capable of classifying monitored and alternate modes of the electrical network, it must be trained. Learning is carried out at the development stage, and its effectiveness depends on the training sample. Correctly chosen dimensionality of the precedent space and the power of the training sample guarantee the unambiguity of the solution to the problem of classifying the modes of the electrical system since shortcomings in the strategy for forming the training sample can lead to an explosive increase in computational costs during training. This effect is called the "curse of dimension". The purpose of this work is to describe the methods of compression of the training sample, based on the identification of boundary precedents of the training sample and getting rid of the ballast of internal precedents that do not take part in decision making. The paper discusses various approaches to managing the size of the training sample. It is shown that the method of constructing a hull, bordering the feature space of the Smart Protection Device, based on the use of alpha forms, allows compressing the training sample without compromising its information capacity. The application of the compression of the training sample of the Intelligent Discriminator of the modes of ground short circuits in the recognition of a single-phase short circuit to ground is demonstrated. The training results confirm that the training set retained its effectiveness even after compression.

Author Keywords: learning of the Smart relay Protection Device

articleTitle: Studying the Arc Fault Characteristics in Low-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Arc faults in LV networks pose quite a serious problem entailing fire breakouts. A special device requiring exact tuning may be used for protection against arc breakdowns. At present, there are quite a number of studies aimed at revealing specific signs pointing to the occurrence of an arc short-circuit fault. The article presents a study of the arc harmonic content involving an experiment on a dedicated facility.

articleTitle: Development of a Motor-Wheel Based on a Brushless Machine of Combined Excitation for Hybrid and Electric Transport
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article shows the advantages of using machines with combined excitation (excitation from permanent magnets and an excitation coil) in comparison with other types of machines for a hybrid car and an electric car. The main advantage of the combined excitation motor is a reduction in overall dimensions due to permanent magnets and a reduction in the price of an electronic control system due to the regulation of the magnetic flux using the excitation winding. The design and principle of operation of the electric motor is described in detail. A digital twin of this motor was created. The results of testing the digital model are shown..

articleTitle: A Modified SHMPWM Algorithm based on the 3L-NPC Converter Connected with the 10kV Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Multilevel inverters have recently received increased attention in high-power applications since they can generate high-quality output signals at low switching frequencies. The three-level neutral-point clamped (3L-NPC) inverter is one of multilevel topologies which is formed from the series connection of IGBTs. In order to seek to improve reliability and efficiency of high-power applications, switching losses and total harmonic distortion (THD) should be reduced in power inverters. Pre-programmed pulse width modulation (PWM) methods, such as selective harmonic mitigation (SHMPWM) and selective harmonic elimination (SHEPWM) techniques, can enable the harmonic profile of the output waveform to be preprogrammed over a range of modulation indices. In this paper, a modified SHMPWM control strategy for NPC-based inverter applications is presented to obtain the switching patterns, which is capable of satisfying grid codes under equal dc link voltages. This method is based on the use of feasible solutions near the regions of infeasible solutions to obtain feasible solutions in these regions. Additionally, the adjustment of the safety factors in the mathematical functions of SHMPWM technique is also applied to try to obtain feasible solutions as much as possible. Finally, several simulation results are provided to verify the effectiveness of the proposed SHMPWM algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Lighting Load Contribution in Modern Apartments
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Nowadays, technological progress leads to a change and expansion of the variety of domestic electric appliances. The character and power consumption of a modern apartment is changing. Currently, the issue of calculating the power consumption of apartments and houses is especially acute due to the constant rapid development of technologies. Incandescent lamps were replaced by energy-saving (fluorescent) lamps, which are currently being replaced by LED lamps. That is why the load spent on lighting has decreased several times. The question arises of updating data on the apartment's electricity consumption and the contribution of lighting to the apartment's power consumption.

articleTitle: The Induction Motor Model for Control Starting in Small-Scale Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: With the development of small-scale generation the issue of conducting reliable starting and preventing stalling of large induction motors in electric power systems with comparable powers becomes especially significant. The conditions of the motor stalling and successful starting in large-scale power systems are well researched. However, those conditions are not acceptable in power systems where generation capacity and induction motors capacity are comparable. Designing automatic devices for successful starting control and preventing stalling of the motor requires the proper models of the critical conditions. Such conditions should consider the predicted variation and current values of voltage, frequency, mechanical torque of the load during motor starting and loading. Application of the critical conditions at the automatic devices allows to prevent initiation of emergency modes in local electric power systems with comparable powers. The successful starting conditions of induction motor and maximum-permissible stability modes for the local electric power systems with the results of the research are presented in the article.

articleTitle: The Predictive Diagnosis Method of Electric Drive State Via an Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of diagnosing the state of electric drive and/or its elements via an artificial neural network in real-time. The proposed method used pre-installed sensors by manufacturers. Additional sensors or devices are not needed to implement this method. The paper considers the relevance of this topic, describes the advantages of the method, explains the algorithm of work. The necessity of using the artificial neural network (ANN) is justified. The obtained ANN trained on data taken from real objects. The data of the training sample are trends values get from sensors during commissioning. Theoretical calculations are confirmed by experimental data. Special attention is paid to the scope proposed method.

articleTitle: Research of the Implementation Possibility of the Precise GPS Positioning Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the applied precision farming systems designed to increase the driving accuracy of agricultural machinery regardless of external conditions, reduce the cost of fuel, fertilizers, seeds, improve the quality of field cultivation and increase yields - parallel driving systems, autopilots and agronavigators. The article considers ready-made solutions for precision farming available on the market, navigation receivers and antennas suitable for precise positioning purposes. The use of freely available software - RTKLib library for accurate positioning using RTK technology (Real Time Kinematic) is considered. The article proposes to create a budget positioning system that will measure the location of agricultural machinery with an accuracy of a centimeter, using the RTKLib library to create an accurate heading guide or agronavigator. The possibility of creating a high-precision GPS / GLONASS navigation receiver was also considered, where data processing using RTK technology occurs on the receiver board itself using a microcontroller, as a result, it was concluded that it is advisable to use 32-bit STM32 microcontrollers with an ARM Cortex-M4 core. To develop a device prototype, it is proposed to use a development board based on STM32 Nucleo and a cloud-based integrated development environment (IDE) Mbed, and for the final serial device, it is desirable to use low-level programming at the register level using CMSIS libraries using software from STM: a convenient STM32Cube initialization code generator, and the Atollic True Studio IDE.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Process of Induction Melting of Corrosion-Resistant Coatings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: An algorithm for solving the electromagnetic problem by the finite element method has been developed. A mathematical model is created on the basis of the geometry and physical properties of the studied induction apparatus and the melting product. The analysis of the distribution of the parameters of the electromagnetic field in the workpiece was carried out using the ELCUT package. The dependences of the integral electrical characteristics of the induction device on frequency and temperature are obtained. An experimental stand was developed on the basis of a CEIA PW3 180/50 induction unit and a frequency-controlled drive, physical modeling was carried out and the results of theoretical studies were confirmed.

articleTitle: Modeling a Semiconductor Compensator Based on a Multifunctional Integrated Electromagnetic Component
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The authors developed a computer model of a semiconductor compensator using a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component (MIEC) consisting of a network modeling subsystem, a power part of the compensator, its control system and load. The need for computer simulation is due to the operating modes of the semiconductor compensator and the high cost of its element base. It allows avoiding the cost of expensive components. The computer model was made in the MatLab Simulink software package. The use of a multifunctional electromagnetic component is justified by the cost of the individual discrete components that make up the semiconductor compensator. Thus, the use of MIEC made it possible to achieve a reduction in the resource intensity of the circuit, its cost, and to increase the reliability of the device. Qualitative results of mathematical modeling are obtained in the form of graphs of the control voltage of the bridge converter and the output voltage of a static semiconductor compensator based on MIEC.

articleTitle: Designing of High Speed Permanent Magnet Electric Machines with Rotor Strength Verification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the design of high-speed electric machines with magnetoelectric excitation, taking into account the required electromagnetic and strength parameters provision. The active part sizes of such machines highly depend on electromagnetic loads – magnetic flux density in the air gap, armature line current density. Magnetic flux density, in turn, is a function of the non-magnetic gap magnitude between the rotor and the stator, which is determined by the thickness of the used permanent magnet (PM) sleeve mounted on the rotor surface. The finite element method is used to study the strength characteristics dependence - mechanical stresses and rotor elements deformation on the method of fixing the PM: glue, sleeve, glue and sleeve at the maximum speed of the autonomous mobile object motor-generator. The magnetic flux density in the gap is verified by the finite element method. guidance’s are given on the choice of the method of fixing the SPM on the rotor and the thickness of the carbon fiber sleeve.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Self-Regulating Eddy-Current Brakes with Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper describes the possibility of control and regulating the electromagnetic torque of the eddy current brakes (ECBs) with permanent magnets (PMs). This achieved by dividing conducting disc rotor on several parts that are connected by springs. Because of interaction between centrifugal forces and spring forces, the rotor parts can take a place in working air gap where the PMs create magnetic field. Since centrifugal forces are determined by the rotational speed, self-regulation of the brake torque is realized. The paper presents the results of simulation of a magnetic field and a method for assessing the electromagnetic moment.

articleTitle: Simplified Time Domain Analysis of the LLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Modern LLC resonant converters have a high efficiency. This allows neglecting the active resistance of the transformer windings, which has been discussed in some known publications. This paper deals with a simplified method for taking into account a magnetizing branch when using a T-shaped equivalent circuit of a two-winding transformer to analyze LLC resonant converter at the time interval of its linearity. As a result, the authors' previous neat description of the LLC resonant converter over its linearity interval by three linear differential equations is reduced to two first-order equations, which may simplify the calculations greatly. In this paper, the equation for determining the initial value of the state vector of LLC resonant converter at the interval of its linearity in the steady-state mode has been solved. The result relationships have afforded grounds for computer modeling of processes in the linearity interval using the parameters taken from the data for the commercial LLC resonant converter developed by the EKRA Research and Production Enterprise, Ltd. (Cheboksary). The modeling of LLC resonant converter using the exact and simplified equations has practically shown their exact match.

articleTitle: Electric Locomotives Energy Saving by the Discrete-Adaptive Traction Drive Control: Experimental Confirmation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper is devoted to studying a freight electric locomotives efficiency increasing. Energy efficiency indicators for various operating conditions were analyzed. The locomotive efficiency in function of tractive power was found by statistical processing of on-board recorder data. The experience shows that electric locomotives energy efficiency in operational conditions is less than nominal value. A locomotive efficiency control system for multi-engine traction drive has been developed, the power utilization factor is chosen as a criterion. As a result, this increases the locomotive efficiency distributing the tractive force over the optimum number of traction motors when operate at partial load. Direct confirmation of the reduction in energy consumption was obtained from operational tests. All other things being equal, when the electric locomotive operates in discrete-adaptive mode in combination with automatic speed control, an increase in the efficiency by 11.1% and a decrease in the specific power consumption for traction by 25% are achieved.

articleTitle: The Logic Equations and Software System to Determine the Practicability of Overhauling or Upgrading the Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper solves the problem of automated decision-making on the quality of stator steel of an induction motor that needs to be overhauled or upgraded. There are three categories of stator steel quality: good steel, satisfactory steel, and low-quality steel. The authors have developed a procedure as well as a hardware and software system to examine the quality of stator steels of malfunctioning induction motors to be overhauled or upgraded at electrical repair facilities. The logic equations determining the quality categories of stator steel have been derived. There have been determined the main criteria defining steel quality: values of the effective current value (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</inf>) and magnetizing power - active power loss in stator steel (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c1</inf>), obtained as a result of automatic processing of the registered signals and measured by ammeter and wattmeter. There have been also defined additional criteria for assessing the condition of stator steel, derived from automatic processing of voltage and magnetizing current oscillograms signals. There has been developed a hardware and software system that implements the methodology of instrumental examination of stator steel of an induction motor to be overhauled or upgraded. The R&D product is recommended for experts of electrical repair and electric machine building companies.

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Fault Location Reliability Improving
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For single-end or double-end traveling wave (TW) fault location it is required to identify the TW front that arrived the first to the installation place of the locator from a short circuit (SC) along the protected power line (used TW front). If the protected power line has a parallel short power line, the TWs fronts along them from the SC reach the measurement place earlier than the used TW front. This dramatically complicates the identification of the used TW front and can lead to significant error in fault location. Traditional methods of identifying the used TW front have low reliability due to the impossibility of accurately measuring the voltage TWs fronts using capacitive and inductive voltage transformers. In this article methods of identifying the used TW front are proposed. Proposed methods only use current TWs measured with high accuracy from electromagnetic current transformers. The proposed methods are developed to improving the reliability of the TW fault location.

articleTitle: Monitoring of the Insulation Resistance of the Power Supply Buses of Autonomous Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents materials on the development of methods and algorithms for monitoring the insulation resistance of tires of autonomous objects with a two-wire DC power supply system. Equivalent circuits, elementary electric diagrams, systems of equations and solution techniques and mathematic simulation results are described. Estimates were given to the measurement accuracy for autonomous objects power supply buslines isolation resistance control (IRC) systems (ships, spaceships, mines, autonomous transport objects, drones etc.). Algorithms, simulation algorithmic models and all the needed technical requirements for hardware-in-the-loop development with an aim to measure isolation resistance in the power supply circuit were prepared. Buslines isolation resistance measurement techniques were enumerated for buslines in different electrical energy complexes, autonomous objects and systems.

articleTitle: Simulated Model Relay Protection Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the task of training relay protection, namely, the task of building the boundaries of the areas of monitored and alternative modes. A method of solving it is proposed, which allows using an object simulation model (IMO) to iteratively identify boundary points of mode regions. The operation of the method is demonstrated by the example of constructing the resistance relay area. Limits of applicability of proposed method are considered, and convergence of iterative process underlying it is also shown. The optimal parameters of the method have been identified, allowing to use it most efficiently.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Approach to SOFC-Based Generation System Control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of the optimal control for a SOFT-based generation system is being solved with a multi-agent approach which allows to take into account the environmental friendliness and low maneuverability of solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs). For the SOFT-based generation system, a SOFC-agent and a load-agent have been created. Algorithms for the agent operation have been developed. To study the multi-agent control system effectiveness, the JADE platform and the RastrWin software package have been used. In the JADE simulation environment, an interaction model of the SOFT-based generation system agents with other agents within distributed energy system (DES) has been developed and investigated. Using the RastrWin platform, a simulation model of the DES electrical network has been implemented and the indicators of steady-state operating modes of the SOFT-based generation system have been investigated. The research results have shown the positive effects achieved when using a multi-agent control system (complete use of the SOFC generated electricity, ensuring the required voltage level on the buses of consumers with a SOFC power plant).

articleTitle: The Proposed Plan of a Syrian 400 Kv Grid Connection Model with the DESERTEC Project in the Syrian Arab Republic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The continuous increase in the demand for energy in the world has prompted the thinking of using renewable energy sources as an alternative to conventional energy sources (fuel, coal, gas ... etc.) due to the low operating costs and the low impact on the environment. In conjunction with these ideas, several projects appeared in the world that use renewable energies, and one of the most prominent of these projects was the DESERTEC project, which aims to optimize the exploitation of these energies by linking the sources of power generation in the countries of the Middle East, North Africa and Europe with each other through the high voltage direct current. In this paper, a proposal will be presented to plan the connection of the power grid in the Syrian Arab Republic 400 kV that operates on alternating current with the DC network DESERTEC. And studying the effect of this connection on the quality of electrical energy in the Syrian Arab Republic.

articleTitle: Influence Investigation of Electric Drive Operation Mode at a Rolling Mill FC with AR on the 10kV Supply Network Voltage Quality
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper considers the influence of frequency converters with active rectifiers in the main electric drives of four-stand mill on the voltage quality of 10 kV distribution network of in-plant power supply system at a metallurgical plant. The investigation was carried out using the initial and improved algorithms of pulse-width modulation of active rectifiers at various operation modes for electric drives of the rolling mill. The advanced algorithm essence was the use of switching angles tables providing the removal of harmonics, falling into the zone of resonances in the frequency response of the network. The current load diagrams of active rectifiers were used in the research to take into account operation modes of rolling mills’ electric drives. The studies were performed on a complex simulation model of the main mill drives and of the internal 10kV distribution network, which was implemented in the mathematical package Matlab-Simulink. The analysis of the research results showed the effectiveness of the improved PWM algorithms in terms of reducing the total harmonic distortion factor on the sections of the main step-down substation in all the static and dynamic operating modes of the rolling mill.

articleTitle: Overview of Existing Systems for Automatic Control of Excitation of Synchronous Generators and Their Adaptation in the Conditions of Industrial Power Plants of Metallurgical Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One of the main types of automation on power plants is automatic adjustment of the excitation of synchronous generators. As the electric power systems and growth in the number of sources of distributed generation, the automatic excitation regulation requirements are significantly increased. At the same time, on the one hand, the pathogens of synchronous machines are improved, and on the other hand, the laws of automatic excitation regulation are complicated. Modern industry generally produces universal excitation systems that can be adapted to any power plant power plant. Of particular interest today are issues of adaptation of excitation control systems to industrial generators and conditions from operation. In this paper, there was an analysis of existing automatic control systems for the excitation of industrial generators, their characteristics, dignity and disadvantages are given in relation to industrial networks of a complex configuration. A feature of such networks is the inclusion of generators on different stages of transformation and, therefore, different conditions for maintaining a given voltage level on the clips. As the analysis of the operational characteristics of industrial generators shows, their excitation systems are not fully adapted to the conditions of local power supply, which in some cases leads to manual regulation. This is due to the work on a high-power network, which changes the voltage, as well as a change in active and reactive loads of machines. As an example, a scheme of the factory power plant complex configuration is shown. The characteristics of the change in the capacity and the voltage of the real industrial generator for the year are given. Conclusions about the need to adapt the excitation control system in industrial power supply conditions. The article provides general recommendations on the ways of improving the excitation systems of synchronous generators of industrial power plants. The purpose of the recommendations is to increase the static and dynamic sustainability of generators in normal, emergency and postemergency regimes.

articleTitle: Development of a Fault Location Method on an Overhead Power Line with a Branch
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Overhead Transmission power lines (OTL) are the most extended and least reliable elements of the electric power system (EPS). Improving the accuracy of fault location (FL) methods on power lines is an urgent task. One of the means of increasing the accuracy of FL methods is the use of digital instrument transformers.The article is devoted to the development of FL methods for power lines with two-way power supply having a branch. The work is a continuation of the development and research in the field of FL based on digital instrument transformers, carried out at the Ivanovo State Power Engineering University (ISPEU). The results of evaluating the accuracy of the method on a network model in Matlab + Simulink are presented.

articleTitle: Determination of the Reliability of Power Supply Systems in High-Altitude Areas from Hybrid Power Sources Using a Logical-Probabilistic Method Based on a Dynamic Failure Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper investigates issues related to the reliability of power supply from autonomous hybrid stations based on renewable sources of wind and solar energy. The considered power supply schemes are from hybrid stations with two wind turbines of 250 kW and ten of 50 kW capacity. Calculations of the annual electricity production are carried out considering the change in wind speed. Failure rate is presented as an exponential distribution for ease of calculation. The reliability of hybrid installations is distributed according to the coefficients: forced downtime, availability and technical use. The transitions of a power supply system from one state to another are described using state graphs. A differential equation of the state matrix is produced. Different types of the proposed schemes are compared on the basis of technical and economic comparison as well as the probabilistic method based on a dynamic fault tree, taking into account the natural factors of wind turbines operation. The sufficiency is proved using probabilistic method based on a dynamic fault tree with an error of 0.04%.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Accuracy of the Standard Elements Method when Modeling the Magnetic Field in Parts of Electrical Machines with Narrow Elements, Angular Zones and Oscillation in Conditions at the Border
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: a variation in the error of calculating the magnetic field of electrical machine parts by standard elements method and finite elements method is analyzed under the influence of such factors as the presence of narrow inclusions in the calculation area, conditions oscillation at the border, variation of magnetic characteristics of materials. The error of vector potential values is estimated at control points of angular zones of magnetic conductor and air gap. Analytical solutions of several test edge problems are used to evaluate the accuracy of the standard elements method in highly elongated narrow elements of the calculation area. The high accuracy of the applied standard elements method is confirmed.

articleTitle: Controlling the Reactive Power of the Enterprise’s Power Supply System with the Task Correction According to the Current Calculation Meter Readings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The industrial enterprise’s power supply system (PSS) reactive power (RP) automated control system (ACS) has been considered, comprising workshop transformer substations with capacitor units and the main step-down substation, from which synchronous motors are powered. The use of this control system allows meeting the regulatory requirements for ensuring the limiting RP factor values and thereby reducing loss when transmitting power and increasing the grid throughput. A mathematical model of a power transformer has been obtained, based on which a structural diagram of a PSS controlled by the RP factor built. Typical ACSs have been considered to control reactive power on the low voltage side of the transformer, from which RP sources are powered: control systems with standard power factor regulators and ACSs with algorithms formed as a function of active and reactive power of power consumers. A system to control the RP factor of the PSS of the entire enterprise has been proposed with the task correction as a function of the current calculation meter readings. The performance of the control systems proposed has been confirmed on an experimental unit with asynchronous and synchronous machines. The control system considered can be used at many industrial enterprises with capacitor units and asynchronous and synchronous motors.

articleTitle: Practice and Prospects for Implementing an Electric Drive Based on a Reluctance Machine with Magnetically Anisotropic Conductive Rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper represents the results of theoretical and experimental studies of an automated drive based on reluctance machines with a magnetically anisotropic conductive rotor (RMMACR) with an installed power of 1.5 to 500 kW. Designs, manufacturing techniques, advantages, and disadvantages of various RMMACR types have been described. RMMACR has been mathematically described and its block diagram built in the rotor d, q coordinate axes. An algorithm for robust control over the drive has been synthesized, which provides for adjusting the magnetizing and load current controllers by a sequential correction to a technical optimum. The drive control system has been synthesized based on two criteria: the fastest response and the highest energy efficiency index. A technique for identifying RMMACR parameters has been described. The results of testing the RMMACR design and the control theory developed have been represented. Theoretical and experimental studies have proved the adequacy of the developed RMMACR design technique with experimental data. The prospects and wide capabilities of an RMMACR- based drive have been shown and proven.

articleTitle: Laser Gyroscope Parameters Measuring System Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Gyroscope with lasers implementation is an important field of study with great potential. An integrating rate gyroscope is called a laser gyroscope (LG). The interference occurs in the form of a lock-in zone (LZ) during the operation of the LG, which leads to insensitivity at low rotation speeds, e.g. a ship, a submarine, where the speed is less than the threshold. In this case, the LG is practically useless in the rotational speed determination. The impact of dithering on the LZ was investigated by modeling the LG operation equation and a measuring stand that reduces the effect of the LZ at low angular velocities was developed.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Effectiveness of the Use of Adaptive Algorithms for Relay Protection of a Large Industrial Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Conventional relays have fixed settings, so it becomes difficult to meet protection requirements in changing power system conditions. The solution to this problem is adaptive protection, which can change its settings or performance in response to changes in the power system. To develop a mathematical model of the relay protection system, the MATLAB software package used, designed to calculate and analyze the steady-state operating modes of the power system, which allows static and dynamic experiments taking into account a large number of random variables. The main advantages of the obtained adaptive algorithms are an increase in the speed of relay protection devices, a decrease in the number of incorrect operations, a decrease in economic damage from an interruption in the power supply and a downtime of the technological process. These models make it possible to build a new model of an electrical network capable of fulfilling all these conditions in a complex.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis for the Optimal Structure of a Multilevel Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: the paper deals with the analysis of the existing topologies for power circuits of multi-level voltage source inverters used as a component of a frequency converter in a variable- frequency electric drive and for other electrical engineering applications. The study expediency for the quality of the output phase and line voltages of inverters has been defined. The rational number of levels for a multi-level voltage source inverters has been specified, taking into account the additional advantages obtained, the increasing complexity of the construction and the power circuit control, economic considerations. Computer simulation models have been developed for the considered inverter circuits. The analysis of the circuits operability for voltage source inverters with different number of levels is carried out by means of modeling. A harmonic analysis of the phase and line voltages for the inverters has been made. Their comparison is carried out according to the resulting harmonic distortion in all investigated versions. Conclusions are made containing recommendations for the use of multilevel inverters with the optimal number of levels.

Author Keywords: phase and line voltages of inverter

articleTitle: Electricity Costs Minimization for an Industrial Building by Reducing Energy Consumption During Peak Load Hours
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper dwells upon optimizing a daily energy consumption profile of an industrial building. The goal is to reduce energy costs by minimizing electricity consumption during peak load hours and optimizing the scheduling of building engineering systems. EnergyPlus is used to simulate the energy consumption of the building. To compensate for the reduced electricity consumption during peak load hours, this paper analyzes various facility scheduling and electricity delivery scenarios including changes to the working hours, using solar panels with or without storage as a local energy source, and using a diesel generator. The authors found that the greatest effect in terms of energy savings for the summer period of the year can be obtained by minimizing electricity consumption during peak load hours, lengthening the working day by one hour, and using solar panels with energy storage as an additional energy source.

articleTitle: Increasing the Reliability of the Centralized Protection of the Digital Substation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Double entry is a system of recording business accounting transactions, used for errors detection. The usage of this approach in differential relay protection (DRP) allows to increase the reliability of the protection system. Current signals measured on the ends of protected units are formed in special matrices. The surplus current signal processing ensures reliable DRP functioning and eliminates needless protection actions in cases of current transformer or communication lines faults. The calculated relations of Markov chains are used for reliability indexes estimation. The obtained results allow us to conclude that the implementation of DRP with the usage of the doubly-entry method is promising for the digital substation.

articleTitle: Developing an Algorithm Used to Automatically Arrange Filling Diagrams of Outdoor Switchgears with Bridge Connection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Drawing up filling diagrams is an important stage in designing substations. This paper presents an algorithm used to automatically arrange filling diagrams of outdoor switchgears with bridge and block connections. Particular attention is paid to studying all possible types of bridge and block connections at 35 to 220 kV, the design of the algorithm used to draw up filling diagrams, as well as the debugging of designed algorithms. The novelty of these algorithms lies in the fact that each of them takes into consideration all possible types of outdoor switchgear arrangements. These include possible substation extension in the future, the addition of current and voltage transformers, and the arrangement of power line cells. The designed algorithms have been executed in the Outdoor Switchgear CAD software.

Author Keywords: the electrical part of stations and substations

articleTitle: Comparison of Thyristor and Transistor Topologies of Converters for Electrolysis on the Example of a Cadmium Electrolysis System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article presents a qualitative result of comparing two topologies of electrical energy converters used for electrolysis of cadmium and located in the cadmium shop at the Chelyabinsk Zinc Plant. The introduction speaks about the relevance of this comparison and its scientific novelty. The second chapter provides the basic theoretical formulas of the electrolysis process to understand the influence of the electrical parameters of the converter. In the third chapter, the topology of a classical thyristor converter of electrical energy for electrolysis of cadmium is presented, with an indication of the advantages and disadvantages, the main disadvantage of which is large switching pulses, which lead to high ripple of the output constant voltage and current. Also in the third chapter, the topology of a transistor (IGBT) converter of electrical energy for electrolysis of cadmium is presented, indicating the advantages and disadvantages, the main advantages are low ripple of the output constant voltage and current, and a higher efficiency. In the fourth chapter, numerical full-scale comparisons of output indicators, direct current and voltage of converters are given, as well as a numerical comparison of energy consumption. In conclusion, it is said about the prospects of using transistor IGBT topology of electrical energy converters instead of thyristor ones.

articleTitle: Hill-Climbing Algorithm for the Wind Turbine Yaw System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Regarding the wind energy conversion system (WECS), wind speed and direction affect its output power. The yaw system is applied for decreasing the influence of wind direction changes on the turbine output power and directly determines the economic benefits of the wind energy conversion system. This paper introduces the working principle of the hill-climbing algorithm for the wind turbine yaw system. The modeling principle of the hill-climbing algorithm S-function is more complicated, error-prone, and difficult to troubleshoot. So this paper uses the Matlab/Simulink basic module to establish a wind turbine hill-climbing algorithm model for the yaw system. The simulation shows that the hill-climbing yaw system model can correctly track the wind direction change, eliminate the yaw error, and then enable the wind turbine to orient to the wind direction and maintain the maximum output power.

articleTitle: Model of the Internal Resistance of the Starter Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: On-board real-time monitoring of the technical condition of the starter battery is possible if a quantitative change in its parameters is measured during operation. The most informative parameter considering the change in both the terminal voltage and the discharge current is the battery’s internal resistance. To determine the battery’s internal resistance, the locked-gear starter motor loading mode was used. The impact of the electrolyte temperature, operating time, and the states of charge and health on the battery’s internal resistance has been experimentally determined. A mathematical model of the battery’s internal resistance is proposed, considering the change in the operating factors. Practical use of this model will allow onboard determining the technical condition of the battery.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Implement Soft Switching at Zero Voltage of Transistors in Push-Pull Converter, with a Throttle at the Input
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The operation of a push-pull converter with an input choke and an autotransformer current divider operating in the soft switching mode of all transistors, which is provided by reversing the instantaneous value of the inductor current, is considered. The implementation of the soft switching condition of all transistors, except for reducing dynamic losses on them, leads to an in-crease in dynamic losses in the inductor and static losses in the circuit due to an increase in the effective value of the inductor current. As a result of the experiment, it was shown that an increase in the variable component of the inductor current leads to an increase in the converter efficiency to a certain level of the average inductor current.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Technical and Economic Effect of Automatic Voltage Regulation Devices for 10/0.4 kV Transformers in Power Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper describes the voltage control problem in distribution electrical networks. The negative factors that contribute to the voltage deviation were analyzed. The existing principles of voltage control in electrical distribution networks were considered: centralized automatic regulation and manual seasonal regulation. It was shown that voltage control on the primary substation is not sufficient in case of high network loading, long length of lines and the broad range of load changing. The technical efficiency and economic feasibility of automatic voltage control devices use on 10/0,4 kV transformers for local voltage control were analyzed. The scope of automatic voltage regulators application in the form of semiconductor devices for the transformer output voltage regulation for distribution substations is shown.

articleTitle: Software Package for Technological System Elements Testing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The procedure for testing complex technological objects both individually and as part of a technological system is a very resource-intensive task. Full-scale tests require qualified personnel presence and a properly functioning technological facility. To simplify such tests procedure, technological objects mathematical models are used, which allow modeling the main characteristic modes with the necessary accuracy, which is necessarily determined by the problem solved during the tests. Many tests include taking into account the influence of other technological system elements on the tested technological object and vice versa. To account for such an influence, it is necessary to have mathematical models that affect the technological object under test, elements for taking into account the entire list of operation and interaction modes. In this article, the necessity of using a technological system complex mathematical model, as part of a software package, for testing its constituent elements is considered. Complex universal mathematical model of an electric power system element structure is revealed, which allows assembling electric power system circuits of arbitrary complexity and configuration.

articleTitle: Development of a Methodology for Ultra-Short-Term Forecasting of Solar Radiation by Determining the Speed of the Cloud Shadow
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Within the framework of this work, a prototype of a system for predicting the arrival of solar radiation was developed. The system is based on the calculation of the speed of the cloud shadow. Some assumptions are made in the work, which can be found in section II. The experimental installation consists of the Arduino Nano platform and three photoresistors, the software part is written in the Arduino and Python programming languages. A feature of this work is getting of data and their processing in real time. In the course of the work, experiments were carried out. The results of the experiments were analyzed and it can be said that the program code works correctly and the speed of the cloud shadow is calculated without errors. Based on the results of the experiments, options for their improvement are proposed, which in the future will allow using the forecasting system at real solar power plants.

articleTitle: State and Development Prospects of ENERNET Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the state and prospects of the scientific and technical direction of the Internet of Energy or ENERNET. ENERNET is a global energy network concept in which energy resources are monitored and managed using information and telecommunication technologies. The paper discusses a multi-level structure for building energy networks, similar to the multi-level structure used on the Internet. This structure allows for control and effective management of energy resources, including distributed sources and storage. Bringing energy sources closer to energy consumers reduces energy losses and improves energy efficiency. The routing of energy flows in the network is carried out using an energy router (ER), similar to a communication router, which forms a two-way transmission of energy in the form of packets similar to information packets. The heart of the energy router is a solid-state transformer (SST) and energy storage. The work was carried out with the financial support of SibSUTIS within the framework of the state assignment under the grant "Development and research of components of intelligent systems for electronics and energy".

articleTitle: Logic Synthesis of Algorithms of 4/3-Circuit Protection Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The reasonability of the development of general (centralized) short-circuit protection of elements of a 4/3 circuit of open switchgears of power plants and substations is shown. Discriminating elements of a current relay and PDR protection, which receive information from current and voltage transformers, are described. The connection diagram is presented and described. The power directions and current magnitudes in different modes, including SC to earth, are analyzed, as well as the relay behavior. Protection actuation conditions are formulated using the Boolean algebra symbols; they are analytically written and minimized. Special attention is paid to the busbar protection operation algorithms and changing from one current relay setting to another.

articleTitle: Non-Contact Methods for High-Voltage Insulator Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article is devoted to the developed non-contact methods of NDT for dielectric elements of electrical equipment during operation under operating voltage. The experience of a team of authors in the development of devices and methods for the diagnosis of partial discharges in high-voltage insulators is presented. Based on the developed devices and programs for processing diagnostic information, a system for monitoring the technical state of high-voltage insulation under operating voltage was created.

articleTitle: On Improvement of the Electric Power Quality Control Mechanism in the Energy System of Russia
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In world practice, the power quality in energy systems is regulated administratively and economically. In Russia, the power quality is currently controlled using only administrative methods, which have not yet proven their efficiency. The provisions of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation set out those responsible for the power quality indicators distortion and the parties, affected by such. Thereat, it is not considered that not all indicators characterize power quality as a generating company product supplied to consumers by a power grid company. These include only indicators, that characterize the frequency and voltage deviations from the rates. In such cases the Civil Code of the Russian Federation legal provisions is fully applicable. The energy supplier may not be responsible for the rest of the indicators. The distortion of such indicators, as a rule, is usually caused by the power consumers themselves. The scope of administrative methods regulating the relations between consumers and energy suppliers should be limited to indicators characterizing the frequency and voltage deviations, which can be achieved by amending Article 542 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. In case of the interferences caused by the consumption, transmission, and distribution technology specifics, economic methods introducing penalties and bonuses should be applied.

articleTitle: Calculation of Eddy Current Losses in Permanent Magnets of Synchronous Turbine Generators by the Sweep Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article presents a method for determining losses in high-speed permanent magnet synchronous machines. Methods for determining magnetic losses in permanent magnets are considered, based on the solutions of the system of equations of Maxwell, Helmholtz and the Umov-Poynting theorem. The influence of the penetration of electromagnetic waves into the permanent magnet and the harmonic spectrum on the losses in permanent magnets from eddy currents is considered. The distribution of the field inside the permanent magnet is investigated and the losses in permanent magnets are determined by solving the system of Maxwell's equations and taking into account the nonlinearity and hysteresis. To solve the equations, the finite-difference method and the sweep method are used. Computer simulation of losses in permanent magnets has been carried out. Comparison of the results of determining losses using the numerical modeling of Maxwell's equations by the finite-difference method and three-dimensional modeling in the Comsol Multyphisics software package is made.

articleTitle: On the Occurrence of Subsynchronous Torsional Oscillations of Gas Turbine Units in an Isolated Energy Area with an Industrial Load
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The causes of the occurrence and development of random non-cyclic vibroactivity of gas turbine units (GTUs) in an isolated energy area with an industrial load have been analyzed. It has been found that torsional vibrations of the rotating GTU parts first occur, causing radial oscillation at frequencies close to the first natural frequency of rotating masses (11.8 Hz). This further leads to the manifestation of resonance phenomena in certain modes, a sharp increase in the GTU gear oscillation level, and the shutdown of all operating GTUs with the complete blackout of the energy area. The main cause of the occurrence of subsynchronous torsional oscillations of the GTUs is the load shedding by large asynchronous motors connected through thyristor variable frequency drives (VFDs). Load shedding leads to the VFD input current amplitude fluctuations, which, in turn, cause oscillations of the GTU load current and shaft torque. Field tests have shown that the modulation of the amplitude of the fundamental harmonic of the non-sinusoidal waveform during load shedding may reach 40 % of the rated value. The lists of top-priority and long-term organizational and technical measures are given, the implementation of which will prevent the occurrence of subsynchronous torsional oscillations of the GTUs and contribute to the reliable power supply to the energy area consumers.

articleTitle: Method for Calculating Increased Frequency High-Voltage Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Development and application of high-frequency alternating current systems is currently relevant. One of the important components of such systems are high-voltage power transformers with an increased operating voltage frequency, made on the basis of a magnetic core made of ferrite or amorphous materials. Such transformers can be used as part of DC-DC converters, charging stations for electric vehicles, devices for electro-thermal processing of materials, etc. The technical literature lacks a comprehensive methodology for calculating and designing such transformers. The publications do not take into account the peculiarities of high frequency AC systems. This work gives an idea of the developed method for calculating high-frequency transformers and the results obtained using the method.

articleTitle: Study of the Effectiveness of the Introduction of Laser Projection System in the Process of Technological Preparation of the Production of Aircraft Structures From Polymer Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The results of an applied study of the effectiveness of laser technologies in the automation of technological preparation of serial production of aircraft structures from polymer composite materials are presented. The article also discusses reducing the loss of expensive composite materials through the use of precise sweeping and cutting machines with CNC and reducing time losses by increasing the speed and improving the quality of manual stacking of composite material by means of using precise blanks and laser projections of the stacking areas. Particular importance in the article is paid to the use of laser technologies in the processes of automation of technological preparation of batch production to achieve a high level of repeatability of products, which will significantly reduce production defects due to the influence of the human factor on the production process.

articleTitle: The Electromagnetic Compatibility and Quasi-Optimal Linear Filtering of Measuring Signals in Power Engineering
