publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The task of quasioptimal linear filtering electrical signals of industrial frequency in input circuits of devices of protection and automatic equipment taking into account requirements of the GOST 32144-2013 to levels and frequencies of harmonic components of electrical voltage. A case of interference with the parameters specified by the EMC nomogram is considered. The physically realizable transfer function of the filter is found. There is a gear function of the filter, and also implementation of such filters is discussed. Are calculated the potential increase in a signal-to-noise ratio in comparison with traditionally used filters. It is given results of simulation of the operation of the developed quasioptimal filters.

Author Keywords: filtration of measuring signals of power supply systems
systems of relay protection and automatic equipment

articleTitle: Combined Equivalent Circuit of a Single-Circuit Power Transmission Line with a Ground Wire
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a combined equivalent circuit for a single-circuit power transmission line with a ground wire. This mathematical model combines the advantages of the methods of phase coordinates and symmetric components. It makes it possible to take into account the asymmetrical arrangement of phase wires and a lightning protection cable on the tower, which is important for the correct determination of the mutual induction impedances and power transmission line capacitance. In this case, there is no need to simulate the entire electrical circuit in phase coordinates, which greatly simplifies the calculations. The results of calculating the parameters of the equivalent circuit of power transmission lines using the proposed equations showed their proximity to the reference data.

articleTitle: Automatic Optimization Operating Time of the Hot Blast Stoves Parallel Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The research presents the method of the automatic operating time adjustment of the hot blast stoves’ parallel mode. Hot blast stove characteristics are deteriorating in the process of hot blast unit operation. Characteristics changes are unpredictable and require constant monitoring to adjust switching moments. The goal of switching times determination is to achieve the highest possible hot blast temperature for the current capacity and condition of each hot blast stove, which increases the overall energy of the hot blast smelting and thus improves the metallurgical process indicators. The PD-controller is proposed for the implementation of an automatic switching times determination process. A signal of the hot blast temperature difference at the end of the blast period is sent to the controller input, and the output signal of the controller will be the ratio coefficient of the operating periods of the hot blast stoves. The choice of period ratio rather than time change itself as the required parameter is due to the necessity of stable total cycle time of the air heater unit operating in parallel mode.

articleTitle: Axial Type Homopolar HTS Machine for Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This work is devoted to the analysis of the magnetic system of an axial type homopolar machine with high-temperature (HTS) field winding. This machine works as motor/generator of flywheel energy storage system with integrated design, when motor/generator is combined with flywheel. For the analysis we used numerical calculations of electromagnetic field based on the integral equation method. The characteristics of electromagnetic torque and electromotive force in no-load mode are calculated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Development Structural Model of the Induction Heater for the Synthesis of Nitride Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The simulation of an induction heater for the synthesis of nitride materials is considered. The developed mathematical model of thermal and thermal processes, developed in the form of a block diagram, allows you to determine the frequency of the current and the power of the power source, as well as to match the inductance with the power consumption. The thermal part of the model takes into account the complexity of indirect heating, which synthesizes heat conduction, radiation, and convection. Simulation allows you to determine the power, frequency of the current and the operating mode of the power source.

articleTitle: Features of the Construction and Use of Small Hydroelectric Power Plants for Power Supply of Mountainous Regions of Tajikistan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes the dynamics of the development of power supply systems in Tajikistan in the 21st century. The predominant development of hydropower is shown, based on the geographical features of the relief of the republic, which is rich in hydropower resources. The tendency of a significant expansion of the construction of small hydroelectric power plants, which are the most effective in addressing the issues of power supply in the hard-to-reach high-mountainous regions of the republic, is noted. The features of electricity consumers in rural settlements and their influence on the formation of requirements for control systems of small hydroelectric power plants are considered. At the same time, the main attention is paid to solving the issues of balancing the output voltage of hydroelectric power plants with a significant asymmetry of phase loads, which is typical for household consumers. It is shown that the simplest and most effective method for the implementation of small hydroelectric power plants, taking into account the peculiarities of their use for mountainous regions, is their complete automation with the maximum use of semiconductor power discrete voltage conversion devices. An analysis of the existing methods for balancing phase voltages is given and a description of a new method based on a discrete voltage converter is given.

articleTitle: Using Information and Measuring Technologies to Improve Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One of the acute problems of energy supply today is providing consumers with both high-quality electricity and reliable and economically justified electricity supply. The use of information and measurement technologies will allow identifying problem areas for their subsequent solution, including improving the efficiency of electricity generation. A steady increase in loads is imposed on the existing distribution networks. Power transmission lines designed according to the consumption standards of the second half of the last century no longer have the necessary capacity, as a result of which the voltage level is reduced far beyond the permissible requirements. Over a five-year period, there has been a sevenfold increase in the number of technological connections in our region. Measurements of electricity quality parameters were made at several dozen transformer substations, as a result, significant inconsistencies with regulatory requirements were revealed. It is also necessary to balance the voltage level and limit the range of its deviations with the help of special equipment, since it is impossible to limit the range of voltage deviations or reduce its asymmetry on existing electrical equipment in electrical networks. As the measurements showed, the level of the reactive power coefficient for the voltage of 0.4 kV and 10 kV is far beyond the standard level, which causes additional losses of electrical energy. The article discusses methods for solving the above problems by using special equipment using information and measurement technologies.

articleTitle: Improving Power Quality in Power Supply Systems for Rolling Mills FC-AR due to the Use of Specialised Passive Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article deals with the way to improve the power quality in in-plant networks of industrial plants with powerful frequency converters with active rectifiers (FC with AF) through the use of specialised passive filters. In recent years, the FC with AFs have become very widespread due to their advantages, such as: 1) possibility of energy recovery in braking modes of electric drive; 2) support of the set value of power factor at the input of AR. At the same time, they have a significant disadvantage, which is the deterioration of voltage quality in the 6-35 kV power distribution network due to the imposition of high-frequency harmonics of input voltage and current of AR on the resonant area of the supply network frequency response. This disadvantage can be eliminated by using special passive filters in the in-plant power networks, which ensure that the main resonance of currents is shifted to a zone free from high-frequency harmonics of the FC with AR. This makes it possible to reduce the harmonic distortion coefficient in the voltage sections of the enterprise MSS. The article presents the results of research on the application effectiveness of specialized passive filters in the system of in-plant power supply of the rolling complex, functioning at CherMK of PJSC "Severstal".

articleTitle: Magnetizing Power at One-Sided Saturation of Power Transformers with Armored Magnetic System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: It is shown that under space weather disturbances, quasi-direct currents in grounded high voltage windings affect the magnetization characteristics of a power transformer with an armored magnetic system. The intensity of the effect of quasi-direct currents on a power transformer depends on the state of its magnetic system, which is proposed to be distinguished by the value of the phase saturation angle as "weak saturation", "moderate saturation", "strong saturation". With an increase in quasi-direct currents, there is a multiple decrease in the equivalent inductive resistance of the magnetization branch and a multiple increase in the total magnetization power. The total magnetizing power is formed from two components. The first is the reactive magnetizing power, it is due to the fundamental harmonic of the magnetizing current, and the second is the distortion power, it is due to the higher harmonics of the magnetizing current. It is shown that the distortion power reaches its maximum value at the phase angle 90 deg. The obtained calculated expressions make it possible to determine the components of the total magnetization power in the entire range of changes in the magnetization reversal mode of a power transformer under the influence of quasi-direct currents up to a complete transition to the region of technical saturation.

articleTitle: Topology of a Boost Balancing Device in a Three-Phase Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Large variations of voltage at consumers from the nominal value and voltages asymmetry in four-wire distribution networks have led to the development of devices for improvement of power supply in these networks. A study on ways to improve the quality of electricity in four-wire 0.38 kV electrical networks in rural areas and private sector was implemented. The problem of using an existing device for a power supply (booster) quality improving is shown and a new device (booster balancer) is proposed. Models of the booster device were developed; with their help a comparative analysis of devices operation for power supply quality improving was implemented. Advantages of the new device were shown on with the help of the analysis mentioned. A schematic method for a new device implementation was proposed.

articleTitle: Differential Tariff Model for Power Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: At present, electricity consumers are not involved in the regulation of consumption regimes in which disturbances that distort the power quality can occur. Legal regulation of the power quality in the absence of incentive tariffs has not been effective for 20 years. It is imperative to bring back incentive tariffs to encourage consumers to participate in consumption regimes and improve the power quality. A new method of differentiating the base tariff, which does not require a fundamental change in the current tariff setting system, is proposed. The differentiated tariff for power quality management includes three components, one of which is the base tariff obtained by the current tariff setting system. The incentive component of the tariff, which provides demand for technical devices to improve the power quality, is the component related to payment for the consequences of the effects of disturbances in the transmission of inadequate quality electricity to all consumers of the grid organization. The compensatory component of the tariff allows not changing the existing methods of calculation of the base tariff. Based on the proposed method, an incentive tariff model has been synthesized to involve consumers in the regulation of consumption modes in which disturbances that distort the power quality can occur. The model uses a tariff to pay for the negative consequences of disturbances in the transmission of inadequate quality electricity for the billing period as a control factor.

articleTitle: Development of a Prototype System for Monitoring the Operating Mode of a Solar Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents a desktop model that includes two solar panels, four motors and microcontrollers, as well as current sensors, temperature sensors, an illumination module and a relay module, with which the following indicators were measured: current strength, solar radiation intensity and temperature. The relevance of the topic of the work under study is described, the purpose and objectives of this work are explained.Physical modeling of the object under study is considered, including the development of a desktop model and programming of a system for obtaining information. Systems for displaying and archiving data have been developed using Arduino software.On the basis of Arduino, the object under study is modeled and descriptions of the demonstration of the work of the desktop model and the receipt of data are presented.The article analyzes an overview on the research topic, the problems of operating energy complexes, and also describes the types of monitoring stations.

articleTitle: Automated System for Physical Fields Measurements Based on a Quasi-distributed Resistive Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper presents a design of the automated system for measuring physical fields based on a quasi-distributed resistive sensor with a tree-like structure. Software for control of an automated measuring system in manual and automatic modes is developed. The sensor is built using the original tree-like structure, which separates the paths of the probing and measuring currents. The prototype of the system based on microcontroller STM32F411, 14-bit current DAC, and 16-bit ADC is developed and tested. The experimental study shows possibility to achieve measurement errors lower than 0.3%. The higher accuracy can be reached with equipment that is more precise. The proposed measuring system can be adapted to measure various physical fields by means of the appropriate resistive sensors.

articleTitle: Skidding Research of a Traction Asynchronous Electric Drive in the Electric Locomotive on a Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The relevance of the work lies in the possibility of using a computer model in the development and research in the FC-AD (Frequency Converter – Asynchronous Drive) system for the electric drive of an electric locomotive. On the developed dynamic computer model of an asynchronous motor for a shunting locomotive, studies of gap selection in the coupling and skidding have been carried out. The purpose of the article is to conduct research on transient processes of the gap selection and skidding on a dynamic computer model of a traction asynchronous electric drive based on the FC-AD system with various control systems. The developed computer model is based on specific parameters of the traction asynchronous electric drive, allows calculating transient processes in the FC-AD system, taking into account skidding and the gap selection. The article has structural diagrams of mathematical models that take into account the operation of the traction electric drive, taking into account various control and skidding systems. On the basis of a dynamic computer model, computer models have been developed for studying transient processes in various control systems when choosing the gaps in the coupling and skidding.

articleTitle: Wattmeter Cards Analysis of Oil-Producing Pumps Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A significant part of oil production wells is operated by sucker rod pump units. Low-speed asynchronous electric motors with increased starting torque are used as drives for well sucker rod pumps. Balancing sucker rod pumping units allows for smoother loading and reduced power consumption. The authors investigated the balance of well pumping units. The impact of balancing on electricity consumption has been assessed. The following research methods were used: statistical analysis of wattmeter cards; mathematical methods for analyzing wattmeter cards with determining the average value of power consumption, the coefficient of imbalance, and the potential for energy saving. As a result, it was found that 2% of well pumping units are balanced. At the same time, 35% of well pumping units have an unbalance coefficient worse than 0.5. The negative effect of insufficient balancing of sucker rod pump units on electricity consumption is shown. As a result of balancing, the energy consumption of well pump drives can be reduced by 5-20% while maintaining production volumes.

articleTitle: Method for Selecting a Set of Image Files Similar to the Object of Interest
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this research, the scientific novelty is the development and testing of the method. This method will allow combining the high speed of the cascade classifier and the quality of the artificial neural network. As an approbation of the work in this article, we study the set of image files. The set of image files are available in the directory on the disk. Next, we select a set of files. The set of files is similar to the object of interest image files. It means, that we can't identical any objects. Then we rewrite files to the target directory. This set should later be used for training a neural network. Images of the object of interest can be in any orientation and on any background. This non-identity must be recognized by a trained neural network. For the purposes of forming such a set, we will need an identifier that has sufficient accuracy for these purposes. Here we do not need very high accuracy. The very identification error of this preliminary analyzer helps us of introducing some dissimilarity between the objects of the images. The task is complicated by the fact that objects can have different sizes (scale) and orientation in space. Our approach based on cascade classifiers and neural networks combines the high speed of the cascade classifier and the quality of the artificial neural network. And the stage of preparing training data for the network is of great importance.

articleTitle: Simulation of Gas Turbine Plant Modes with Prognostic Controllers in an Isolated Power Supply System with Asynchronous Load
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Generators with relatively low capacity using different types of primary motors can be used to supply power to consumers in distant locations from network infrastructure. In particular, gas turbines can be used to drive such generators. In conditions of load variations, and in emergency modes, frequency and voltage deviations in isolated power supply systems (IPSS) with gas turbine plants can exceed the permissible limits. These deviations can be reduced using automatic controllers. However their setting by traditional methods requires quite complicated calculations when identifying the object's dynamic characteristics and when determining optimal parameters of automatic control systems. Prognostic algorithms allow to use factory settings of controllers for all operating modes while changing only one parameter – the forecast time, which is urgent when gas turbine plants should be put in operation promptly. The article provides computer study results of the study of prognostic algorithms influence on gas turbine plant voltage and rotor speed control quality operating in IPSS with relatively powerful asynchronous load. The simulation results indicated that the use of prognostic algorithms allows to reduce oscillation and transition process time for voltage and generator rotor speed; it ensures the necessary stability margin, increases survivability of an isolated power supply system and renders adaptive properties to it.

articleTitle: Damping of Oscillations by Weak Nonlinear Regulator with Extended Range of Quality Control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Control problems for objects prone to oscillations in automatic control systems often arise in practice. In some confirmed cases, for almost linear systems it is useful to use linear regulators, otherwise, control objects are nonlinear. Moreover, its nonlinearity cannot be fully compensated by inverse nonlinearity at the object input. In a low-signal mode, transient processes in nonlinear systems can be ideal, but with small changes in the input amplitude, the transient processes can become unstable without a qualitative change in the state. The methodology for ensuring parametric invariance is actively developing. In particular, numerical methods are designing to ensure parametric invariance for systems with indefinitely mathematical descriptions. This paper offers two options for solving the problem of ensuring parametric invariance, which makes it possible to find a parametric synthesis of the system and find some compromise version of the regulation for extended input amplitude ranges. The proposed method is investigated by numerical simulation, and its effectiveness has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Vibrodiagnostics of the Mechanical Frequency Converter as a Part of Induction Installation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Induction installations are used in the pipe production process to heat billet pipes. They are integrated into the production line. According to the results of practical data, a considerable part of the failures in induction installations linked to failures in power supplies, namely with defects in frequency converters. At present, mechanical frequency converters are still often used as frequency converters in induction installations, therefore, increasing the reliability of their operation is an urgent and significant task. The research of a mechanical frequency converter of an induction installation on the example of an operating converter is described in the present paper. A review and analysis of various methods of vibrodiagnostics to assess the equipment state are carried out. The evaluation of the main defects in the investigated installation is given and the reasons for their appearance are studied. An experimental research of a mechanical frequency converter by vibrodiagnostics methods was carried out to confirm the theoretical conclusions. The recommendations to improve the reliability of mechanical frequency converters received based on theoretical analysis and practical results are given in the paper.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of an Algorithm on Graphs to Determine the Structural Reliability of Electrical Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Because of the increasing number of accidents in electric power systems and the danger caused by their consequences, there arises an urgent need to assess the reliability of electric power systems operation. The aim of this study is to develop a method to assess electric power systems reliability with the aid of an algorithm on graphs and to describe its software implementation. The reliability of electric power systems is divided into structural and functional. The calculation of structural reliability indicators is based on the criterion of disconnection between the source and the load in the electrical network. Meeting the criterion means that there is no connection of a certain node (load) of the electric power system with the sources. In this article the possibility of using Dijkstra algorithm for calculating the structural reliability of an electric power system is justified and the calculation method is proposed. An analysis of the structural reliability of a regional 330 kV electric power system is presented.

articleTitle: Impact of Wire Cross-Section on System Steady-State Stability without Automatic Excitation Control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Development of the energy sector results in transmission of huge amount of energy across the significant distance. The growth of power plants capacity and the distance of power transmission, the enlargement of power systems lead to the problem of ensuring the stability of generators parallel operation. Loss of stability leads to large variations and fluctuations in operating parameters, causing damage to the equipment of power plants and networks and shutdown of a large number of consumers. Such accidents are accompanied by severe economic and social consequences. Modern technologies have a variety of tools to improve the level of power system stability. The purpose of this article is to study the issues of increasing the steady-state stability of the electric power system using controlled series compensation.

articleTitle: Modulation of the Power Transformer Magnetizing Inductance by Variations of Geomagnetically Induced Currents during Geomagnetic Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: It is shown that the variations of geomagnetically induced currents (GIC) in high-voltage (HV) windings that occur during geomagnetic disturbances cause modulation of the inductive magnetizing reactance due to saturation of the power transformer magnetic system, the depth of which depends on the saturation phase angle. The modulation kinds and the dependences of the magnetizing branch inductive reactance on the saturation phase angle are determined. The extent to which the magnetizing branch equivalent inductive reactance decreases is quantified. In particular, as the saturation phase angle increases to 40 deg, the magnetizing branch equivalent inductive reactance decreases by a factor of around 33.4, a circumstance that has to be taken into account in load flow calculations of electric networks under the conditions of geomagnetic disturbances.

articleTitle: Research of the Characteristics of Induction Motor with a Single-Phase Frequency Converter in the Matlab Simulink Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Three-phase squirrel cage induction motors are widely used in agriculture. This type of motor is used in electric drives of various electrified machines: grinders, pumps, electric saws, etc. In some cases farms are located in remote areas where single-phase power is the most common. In such case the necessity to start and operate a three-phase induction motor from a single-phase power may arise. Thus, an original device that enables to start and operate a three-phase induction motor from a single-phase power has been developed. This article presents the results of a study of the operation of a three-phase induction motor with a single-phase-to-three-phase transistor frequency converter. A simulation model of the developed electric drive was created in the Matlab Simulink environment. For the study, the parameters of a squirrel cage induction motors of the AIS56V4U3 brand were used. A comparison of the characteristics obtained during the operation of an electric drive with a transistor converter and capacitor start.

articleTitle: Development of a Method for Providing the Breaking Capacity of High-Voltage Circuit Breakers using an Adjustable Deceleration of the Short-Circuit Clearance Time
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of ensuring the breaking capacity of high-voltage circuit breakers with an increase in the level of short-circuit currents. Instead of replacing the switches with more powerful ones, it is proposed to use an adjustable deceleration in the protection action on opening the circuit breaker in order to reduce the aperiodic current to an acceptable value at the moment of opening the main contacts. The application of electromechanical relays with intermediate saturable transformers to slow down the protection action is considered. Models of these relays were developed using MATLAB Simscape library, studies were carried out on the models, which confirmed the effectiveness of deceleration. For use in microprocessor protection terminals, a digital algorithm for slowing down the shutdown is proposed. For its application, a method has been developed for determining all parameters of the short-circuit current from its oscillogram. The algorithm has been tested on a mathematical model in MATLAB Simulink, its effectiveness has been confirmed for various initial conditions and influencing factors. The limitation of the proposed deceleration method associated with possible saturation of current transformers at the initial moment of a short-circuit is noted. It is proposed to apply the developed algorithm in conjunction with digital current transformers.

articleTitle: Communication Network Analysis Based on Reliability Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers the behavior forecasting of an infocommunication system depending on the amount of traffic transmitted and the reliability of communication lines. The article aims to determine the optimal data transmission route. The optimality criterion was chosen as a path limited by the number of transit sections. The article presents an algorithm for solving the problem that consists of two stages. At the first stage, the main parameter is the bandwidth of the communication line. The task is to determine the network section bounded by a set rank of paths. A mixed network graph is compiled. The problem is solved by the graphical and matrix method. The result of the solution is presented as a list of routes recommended for traffic transmission. At the second stage, the main parameter is the availability of communication line included in the selected list of recommended paths. A mathematical model of the communication line functioning has been compiled. Link failures are detected by the combined monitoring system. Estimation of availability factor and values of average time in communication line with the inoperative state is performed. The article allows to obtain a number of dependency graphs that represent the solution to the problem of the maximum amount of transmitted traffic finding.

Index Terms: Pairs Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of the Stable Rotation State of the Rotor of an Electric Machine with Sliding Bearings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Electrical machines are used in many areas of technology. These include AC and DC electrical machines. The design of such machines consists of a stator, a field winding, a rotating rotor strung on a shaft into which sleeve bearings are inserted. When operating electrical machines in a loaded state, vibrations can occur, which are transmitted to the main parts of the machine, causing noise, and can lead to the appearance of microcracks in metal structures. Such phenomena also affect the efficiency of an electric machine and subsequently can lead to breakdown of components and assemblies. The work investigates the stability of rotation of the rotor of an electric machine on plain bearings. Resonance frequencies for this case are obtained by solving differential equations. It is shown that a simultaneous increase in the stiffness coefficients of both movable supports of the rotor in the horizontal direction leads to a decrease in the values of the natural frequencies of its vibrations. The results of the work will find application in instrumentation and electrical engineering.

Author Keywords: stability of operation of an electric machine

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Corrosion Cracks in Grounding of Electrical Substations with their Stochastic Origins
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents numerical studies of mathematical models of corrosion cracks in grounding devices of electrical substations on the basis of ordinary differential equations with fluctuations of the crack initiation and on the basis of partial differential equations with different initial distributions of the random value of the crack. The results obtained are useful in studying the stochastic dynamics of deformational destruction of grounding materials, devices and systems both of electrical engineering and electric power industry. The research technique outlined in the work is especially relevant for practical application to predict all kinds of corrosion destruction processes in order to reduce emergency situations in electrical networks of various voltage classes.

articleTitle: Filter Reed-Switch Current Protections
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Filters for symmetrical current components can be designed with the use of not only ferromagnetic current transformers, but also with inductors and reed switches. Reed switches are preferable, but this design should include duplication and self-diagnostics to ensure reliability. A measurement unit on the basis of reed switches fixed near the coplanar phases of an electrical installation to be protected is suggested. It simultaneously functions as a current relay and a negative-sequence current filter. The reliability of its operation is ensured by the design simplicity, self-diagnosis of malfunctions, and duplication of elements. A technique for calculating the parameters of the current filter elements is developed. It consists of 29 formulas, most of which are used for the calculation of the coordinates of the reed switches and of the inductions of magnetic fields affecting them. The features of operation of protection with this measurement unit and self-diagnostics procedures are described.

articleTitle: Improving the Two-Position Ladle-Furnace Efficiency Using Advanced Electrical Mode Control Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The share of steel produced by smelting in electric arc steel-making furnaces with subsequent processing of the melt in a ladle-furnace has significantly increased in the metallurgical industry in recent years. It is necessary to say that electric steel-smelting complexes consume a lot of energy. For this reason, an urgent task is posed to reduce costs and increase productivity at the same time, which is achieved by reducing the operating time under current. The article presents an improved algorithm for controlling the electrical modes of a two-position ladle-furnace installation based on data on the harmonic composition of the electric arc current, which takes into account changes in the argon blowing mode and slag mode. The article presents the structure of the improved control algorithm, which is successfully applied at one of the plants in the Russian Federation. The effectiveness of the algorithm was also assessed using experimental data, which was obtained on the ladle-furnace installation.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Operating Modes of Electric Drive in Bow Thruster as a Part of the Ship Electrical System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Autonomous electrical power systems using parallel operation of diesel generator sets are widely used in various scope of human activities. Ensuring the proper quality of electricity and an uninterruptible power supply to autonomous electrical power systems is a complicated and important task because the safety of people and goods depends on their successful implementation. The operation of powerful AC electric drives, comparable to power of asynchronous motors creates the most complicated operating modes and requires carrying out a research. The "Yeisk" sea ferry was chosen for scientific research. It has a thruster with a variable-pitch propeller and an induction motor with a power of 135 kW, which is the most powerful AC electric drive onboard the ship. Oscillograms of currents, voltages and active power of parallely operated generators were obtained in all the operating modes of the bow thruster as a result of the experimental studies. They provide comprehensive information about the parameters of electromechanical processes during the operation of an electric drive comparable to the power of an electrical power system. Power exchange oscillations were recorded between the parallel operated synchronous generators of the marine power plant in all the operating modes of the thruster. The results of the study confirm the need to apply methods and means of eliminating power exchange oscillations. It seems very useful and necessary to get acquainted with the time and amplitude characteristics of the electromechanical processes by the maintenance personnel of ship’s electrical power system. It is recommended to carry out similar studies for all the autonomous electrical power systems including powerful electric drives.

articleTitle: Development of the System "Network Analytics" for Analyzing Data Received from Power System Protection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the development of the "Network Analytics" system for analyzing oscillograms with power system protection, which will automatically collect and aggregate data on a remote server and display possible causes of accidents on power lines based on intelligent analysis. The article provides the structure of the system, the general algorithm of work and describes the main modules. The work algorithms of the module for analyzing emergency data from high voltage stations are shown. A test version of the system based on a user web interface is presented, which displays data in real time from a laboratory stand, as well as displays alarm oscillograms and indicates possible causes of failures.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Instrumentation Amplifiers Errors by Simulation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Currently, instrumentation amplifiers are widely used to construct measurement channels of measurement and control equipment. This amplifiers are differential, which makes it possible to obtain an output signal proportional to the difference between the input voltages. The value of the voltage gain, depending on the design features, can be set by using an additional external resistance, external jumpers or by applying an external control digital code. Like any measuring transducer, an instrumentation amplifier is characterized by an additive, multiplicative, and nonlinear error component. Accounting for each of the listed error components in the total measurement error of the considered signal parameter is often a difficult task. For this reason, simulation modeling is widely applied. This paper discusses the principles of constructing a model of an instrumental amplifier, taking into account the imperfection of its transfer characteristic. The presence of additive and multiplicative components of the error, transfer function nonlinearity, magnitude response, finite input and output ranges are taken into account. An existing model obtained by using the Spice-model in Tina-TI program (developed by Texas Instruments company) is considered and a model was performed by using the Simulink software program. The resulting model makes it possible to simulate instrumental amplifiers of all known types, as well as decisive amplifiers, dividers and other analog and digital measurement converters.

articleTitle: Measuring the Geometry of Half-Cylinders in a Pipe Production Line on a Basis of an Omnidirectional Vision System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The existing measuring systems for controlling the geometry of the half-cylinder of the mill pipes have a number of disadvantages: low energy indicators; long lead time of the technological process; the complexity and ambiguity of the operating algorithms. This paper presents a modernized algorithm for controlling the geometry of half-cylinders for the proposed vision system. The proposed theories and methods are tested on the basis of the developed virtual environment which was made similar to real technological process. In real experiments, there is a measurement uncertainty, which complicates the comparison of methods with each other. In addition, under real conditions it is difficult or impossible to estimate values of certain parameters. The virtual environment, in turn, eliminates these problems. The vision system proposed in this paper contains fewer electrical components and mechanical connections than a standard measuring system, which increases the reliability of the system. Moreover, with the proposed system, the cross-section of the half-cylinder can be scanned continuously, therefore, the energy parameters of the installation increase and the time of the technological process decreases.

articleTitle: Reed Switch Protection Devices with Symmetric Component Filter without Current Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article provides a diagram of a sequence filter on sealed contacts with windings for electrical installations with a delta phase configuration. The theoretical framework is given for arranging protection, executing the current shut-off functions and sequence filters. The choice of filter parameters and methods for vector plotting that characterize its behavior are proposed. It describes a calibration method of filter-combined current on sealed contacts for an electrical installation with conductors located at the corners of an equilateral triangle. A protection feature calculation method based on determining the coordinates of sealed contacts close to a triangular phase structure is developed. The calculation by the triggering feature of the conventional overcurrent protection is offered. An example of the protection trigger settings selection and the sensitivity verification is described.

articleTitle: Optimization of the 220 Kv Power Grid by Reactive Power
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of active power loss and voltage in the 220 kV electric network in the Northern part of the electric system of the Republic of Tajikistan. This problem is caused by the lack of reactive power com pentation in the nodes of the distribution network with a voltage of 10 kV and the transfer of the necessary reactive power to consumers via the electric network with a voltage of 220 kV or lower. In the nodes of the 10 kV distribution network, the maximum values of active and reactive power obtained by calculation are given. To solve the problem of reducing active power and voltage losses, it is proposed to decentralize reactive power compensation by placing reactive power compensation facilities on the 10 kV side. In order to justify the effectiveness of decentralization of reactive power compensation with the installation of reactive power compensation facilities on the 10 kV side, calculations were performed for all high-voltage substations of the Northern electric power system of the Republic of Tajikistan, as well as on the basis of the real existing 220 kV electric network for one node consisting of two transformer substations (TS Sughd - 500 and TS Hadzhent substations), using the Matlab software package, Power Systems built a computer model for optimizing the 220 kV power grid by reactive power.

articleTitle: Electric Drive for Anti-Icing Overhead Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers one of the options for combating ice overhead power lines in the form of an electromechanical device. Due to different climatic conditions, the problem of icing and methods of combating icing is relevant in modern energy. Often, the problem of icing leads to a break in power lines, which in turn leads to a disconnection of electricity consumers, and entails large economic losses. Timely de-icing reduces the risk of breaking power lines and increases the stability of the power grid. The paper considers a mathematical model of an electro-spring device that allows you to deal with icing. The design of the electric drive is based on a spring mechanism, which made it possible to become economical, technologically advanced and easy to operate relative to the known devices for anti-icing overhead power lines.

Author Keywords: methods of dealing with icing of power lines

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Electric Drive Based on HTC for Traction Applications in Heavy Tracked Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A new type of energy-efficient electric motor is considered as a traction drive for the electromechanical transmission of the DET-400 tracked tractor. Field regulated reluctance machines offer high energy efficiency and high specific torque. The article provides a comparison between field regulated reluctance machine and various types of traction electric drives, specifically an induction motor and a motor with permanent magnets. The issues of FRRM with HTC design are considered, attention is also paid to the optimization of the geometric parameters of the electric machine to achieve the best energy efficiency. As a result, the FRRM with HTC was designed for traction applications based on the real requirements of a Russian-made crawler tractor.

articleTitle: Research of the Powerful Grid Synchronous Motor's Soft-start on a Computer Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A large number of unregulated electric drives based on synchronous motors (SM) with a capacity of 1-20 MW and a voltage of 6-10 kV remain in operation at existing metallurgical enterprises. Such machines are used as drive engines of broadband rolling mills, turbochargers of oxygen stations, high-pressure pumps and converter units. As a result, the problems of increasing the efficiency of such energy-intensive consumers with the optimization of their start-up and operation under load remain relevant. The construction of an automatic excitation control system (AEC) largely depends on the operating conditions of a synchronous motor. The drives of rolling mills are characterized by a sharply variable (shock) load, and for pumps and compressors — almost constant. In this paper, the problem of starting the SM converter unit of the four-cell continuous rolling mill of the Rolling Mill Shop №5 (RMS-5) of PJSC «Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works» is considered. A scheme is proposed and theoretically justified in which one of the DC generators on the SM shaft is used as a drive motor during start-up (before the process of synchronization of the SM with the network), and its armature circuit and the excitation winding circuit are powered by an additional complete thyristor converter of the SINAMICS series. An analysis of the existing SM’s start-up system in asynchronous mode was performed; oscillography of current and voltage on 10 kV Substation №94 buses; an updated calculation of power losses in the original circuit. Complex studies of transients on the developed mathematical model of the soft-start device were performed, the calculation and selection of power equipment for the proposed scheme were made.

articleTitle: The Recloser Placement Optimization Using Digital Network Twin Tools
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One of the options for increasing the reliability of the medium voltage radial distribution network as an object of a digital network twin, made on the PSS®SINCAL computer platform, is considered. The task of increasing reliability by reducing the duration of disconnection of damaged network sections is solved by installing a sectioning recloser. In an extended radial distribution network with many branches and laterals, to determine the optimal location of the partitioning recloser, it is necessary to solve a complex problem with a number of criteria and restrictions. The proposed solution method is based on the algorithm based on the data of sequential walk-around of the feeder and laterals when searching for damages. The modification and simplification of the original circuit is carried out by converting the load node into a feed node. In this case, there is a transition from the use of a nonlinear function of the length of the radial distribution network to a functional linear dependence of the number of power nodes. The calculations take into account the corresponding values of the SAIFI criterion. The pre-installation location of the recloser meets the minimum SAIDI criterion. The typical smoothing of the broken curve of the objective function allows you to determine the extremum point and find the optimal location for the recloser. The features of solving the optimization problem are shown using a typical example. The expected duration of consumer outages is reduced to the values of 80.4 – 81.3%.

articleTitle: Approaches to Voltage Control in Distributed Generation-Enabled Nodes of Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One particular feature of distribution grids is that they have a substantial static stability margin in terms of active power in supervised grid segments. However, when the load curve deviates from the scheduled (projected) values due to a drastic change in weather or for other reasons, intolerably long emergency overloads may occur in the grid equipment. This paper proposes using an overload safety factor provided that the grid-wide load grows proportionally to the initial load; this measure will help prevent potential current overloads. It presents an approach to making adjustments to change in reactive load as active load grows at each step of parameter incrementation; further adjustments are made for different operating scenarios and for the load composition. The paper further substantiates the effectiveness of clustered voltage control of generator sets (GS) at distributed generation (DG) facilities within a single area. In order to calculate the steady-state parameters, one needs to take into account the available reactive power of the GS’s as dependent on the active power load and on the voltage. The paper investigates the effectiveness of shedding part of the active power load from a DG GS to load it in reactive power. It presents the parameter estimates that help estimate how GS load-shedding could affect the parameter incrementation capacity of the microgrid without jeopardizing the load and the grid.

Author Keywords: controlling the voltage and reactive power

articleTitle: Merging Roles in the Production of Massive Online Electric Drive Courses
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The concept of merging the roles of producers of online courses is considered. It is relevant if it is necessary to quickly develop online training courses on electric drive or when converting a full-time training course into a hybrid format. The economic and technological aspects of the proposed approach are considered. Authors' capture of all the roles required to produce online courses can reduce costs and, in some cases, even improve product quality. To capture all the functions necessary for production, authors must master the technologies of capturing video from a computer screen, editing video, recording sound, editing audio tracks. To study modern electromechanical systems and electric drive control systems, knowledge of electrical machines, power electronics and control theory is required. When preparing online courses on electric drive, it is imperative to include practical exercises that are implemented using the Simulink or SimInTech visual modeling environments.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Application of Energy Storage Systems in Energy Complexes with Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper presents mathematical model of electrochemical energy storage. The model was implemented in the MATLAB Simscape. A model optimization method was proposed by changing its internal structure. Optimization made it possible to take into account the change in the internal resistance of the battery during the discharge process and significantly increased the simulation accuracy. The conclusion about the simulation accuracy is made on the basis of a comparison of the simulated discharge curves with the experimental curves that were obtained by research of a lead-acid battery as a part of a laboratory complex. An analysis of the applicability of the proposed mathematical model was carried out, in which various methods for calculating the battery mode are compared. The use of the proposed mathematical model of the battery is reasonable. Further development and optimization of this model will make it possible to use it for calculating the operating modes of electrochemical energy storage units in real electric power complexes.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Transmission Capacity of Distribution Grids Powering Oil and Gas Production Facilities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The impact of reactive power loss on the operating parameters of distribution grids powering oil and gas production facilities has been analyzed. It is shown that the active and reactive power losses in distribution grids significantly depend on the reactive power compensation at the consumption node; they reach minimum values at full compensation and significantly increase at incomplete or overcompensation, and the higher the Q-factor of the distribution grid and the reactive power factor of the load the greater the loss. It is shown that with full compensation of the reactive power of the load, the voltage loss can be further reduced by reducing the reactive power loss in the distribution line. The possibility of increasing the distribution line capacity by 1.33-1.67 by creating a natural power transmission mode to compensate for reactive power loss has been justified.

articleTitle: Digital Protection and Automation Devices RTDS Model Tests Conducting with Digital Data Transmission Protocols Using
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Methods for modeling power systems modes and testing relay protection devices using real-time modeling complexes and using computer software systems that allow modeling in a conventional time scale are considered. Informational input signals of protection during simulation in the conditional model time mode are obtained in the computational experiment course, and protection devices tests are carried out using hardware-software test complexes using calculated input signals. The power system stability study when changing the generating and consuming electrical equipment modes, the relay protection devices state requires testing using digital simulators in a closed loop mode. At the same time, feedbacks between the power system model operating in real time and external devices or their models should be determined (modeled). Real-time simulation was carried out and an using digital power system simulators for real-time simulation (RTDS simulator) world experience analysis was carried out. RTDS complexes use examples by foreign power companies for testing relay protection and control systems, testing the various equipment and automatic control devices interaction, analyzing cybersecurity and assessing the power systems under emergency situations various scenarios functioning are given. To check the relay protection devices performance without taking into account the power system response, tests can be carried out in an open loop mode using hardware and software test complexes. Methods for testing relay protections and their models in open-loop mode are proposed.

articleTitle: Thyristors Balancing Voltage Regulator with Boost Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper examines the problems of improving the power supply quality in four-wire distribution networks of 0.4 kV. The reasons leading to the quality deterioration of the electricity supplied to the consumer are considered. −The operation of known voltage regulators providing stabilization and balancing load voltage is analyzed, their advantages and disadvantages are shown. A new approach to the development of regulator for balancing power supply currents and voltages of the loads based on boost voltage is proposed. The mathematical analysis of electromagnetic processes of proposed devices illustrating efficiency of their work is shown. As an example, the effectiveness of the device installed in a network with an asymmetrical three-phase load is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Study on the "Dead Zone" of the Operation of the Automatic Device for Elimination of the Asynchronous Operation of Overhead Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The general information on the existing automatic devices for the elimination of the asynchronous operation (AEAO) and their application on overhead power transmission lines (OHL) is given, as well as deficiencies in their operation in terms of blocking by the minimum voltage are noted. The presence of "dead zones" of the AEAO device actuation according to the "angular" principle, that are detected during tests on the given settings, is shown. An experience exchange gained during the commissioning of AEAO devices on 110 kV overhead power transmission lines in the electrical network of the distribution grid complex of the branch of PJSC Rosseti Kuban was carried out. The methodology for calculation of the "dead zones" of the AEAO device actuation and taking them into account in the design, as well as in the formation of the task for the settings of the AEAO device is recommended.

Author Keywords: automatics of elimination of asynchronous operation

articleTitle: Investigation of the Robust Stability of a Gas Turbine Engine
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The present paper considers the speed control system of a single-shaft gas turbine engine (GTE). A well-known transfer function of the GTE has been modeled in the Matlab environment. A digital PID controller has been calculated that provides the preset dynamic performance indicators of the discrete GTE speed control system functioning. An assessment of the robust stability of the GTE control system has been performed. A modified root locus for the transfer function with interval coefficients has been constructed. The graphical method is based on the application of the strong Kharitonovs theorem which provides a visual demonstration of the absolute robust stability of the GTE speed control system.

articleTitle: Ferroprobe Magnetometer with Preset Excitation Field Induction Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: A new type of ferroprobe magnetometer was proposed to detect subsurface items. Operating characteristics were improved by making use of an auxiliary bias field caused by a permanent magnet. It was proposed to use a generator capacitor as an excitation element; the generator capacitor coatings are connected to a sine-wave oscillator and are designed as thin-walled semicylinders enclosing the ferroprobe core and the specified permanent magnet. The measuring instrument structure flowchart was presented, its operating principles and design features were considered. It was shown that by setting different relationships between the intensity values of magnetic fields generated by the generator capacitor and the permanent magnet, one can implement different ferroprobe operating modes. This characteristic of the proposed ferroprobe can be used to solve various tasks connected with subsurface items detection and identification

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Solar Irradiance Forecasting Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes the development of a day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting model in an hourly resolution. A statistical model based on the method of artificial neural networks with a multilayer perceptron architecture was chosen as a forecasting technique. The ground measurements of solar radiation and the weather archive, consisting of the main meteorological quantities, were used for training the model. The selecting of optimal input data combination and hyperparameter tuning were carried out according to the criterion of the minimum error. The developed model on the basis of the multilayer perceptron consists of 5 inputs, 64 neurons in a hidden layer with 1 neuron in the output layer. In the process of predicting the hourly average solar irradiance on a tilted surface, numerical weather forecast data (total cloudiness, air temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure) provided by two different weather services and the cosine of the solar incidence angle as a geometric/temporal parameter were used as the input variables.

articleTitle: The Application of Mathematical Modeling and Instrumental Control for Optimization of Electric Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Mathematical modeling and instrumental control as innovative methods that can justify the introduction of energy-saving measures and technical solutions in the power supply systems of industrial enterprises are described in the article. The evaluation of the implementation of innovative methods of energy saving in electric drive and power supply systems at mining enterprises showed the possibility of obtaining a multiplicative economic effect with the right approach to the introduction and subsequent operation of energy-saving technologies. The potential of energy saving in the industry in general, and in mining enterprises in particular, was shown. As an example, in some areas of enterprises, such measures as reactive power compensation, the introduction of frequency-controlled electric drive systems, the development and implementation of systems for continuous monitoring of electricity quality indicators were considered. The method of mathematical modeling was implemented using the MatLab software package, which is well-established in engineering calculations around the world. The accuracy of the simulation results reached 95%. Instrumental control was carried out in accordance with the requirements of the standards for 7 days with a 10-minute interval. Frequency deviations, slow voltage changes, non-sinusoidality, etc. were evaluated. As a result of optimization of individual electric power systems, the total economic effect due to energy savings were achieved, approaching 28 million rubles per year, which is on average 20% of the total electricity consumption in the considered areas of mining enterprises.

articleTitle: Electricity Costs Control with Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Models and methods of organizational control of electricity costs in a 3-level company under conditions of uncertainty are considered. The human factor is taken into account in the form of activities associated with the presence of the elements of the lower levels of the company’s hierarchy of their own goals. These goals do not coincide with the goals of senior managers. Such active elements may choose their electricity costs metrics to maximize their own target functions, rather than the target functions of senior managers. With insufficient awareness of managers, such activity of the elements of the company can lead to overestimation of its electricity costs. To avoid this, the managers of the top two levels are advised to use training procedures based on machine learning algorithms, as well as supervisor’s instructions. In addition to this, the company’s electricity cost management mechanism includes ranking and incentive procedures at the lower two levels of the company. The solutions of the games of the active elements of these levels of the company with higher-level managers are determined. These solutions depend on the used mechanism for managing the costs of electricity. Sufficient conditions have been found for the synthesis of a mechanism for minimizing these costs, in which the active elements of the company make full use of their opportunities to reduce these costs. The results obtained are illustrated by the example of a mechanism for reducing electricity costs for wagon repairs in the management system of JSC Russian Railways.

articleTitle: Estimation of Deep Bar Induction Motor Equivalent Circuit Parameters from Starting and Load Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The method for experimental determination of the deep-bar induction motors equivalent circuit parameters from normal operating conditions, such as no-load, starting and operation with various loads has been proposed. In these modes, instantaneous discrete values of currents, stator voltages and slip are measured and stator input resistances are determined, which are used to identify the equivalent circuit parameters of the IM with trapezoidal rotor rods. For the latter, the influence of the skin effect is taken into account using the provided analytical expressions for the skin effect coefficients for resistance and inductive reactance. The advantages of the equivalent circuit with trapezoidal rods in comparison with the generally accepted rectangular ones are shown. The efficiency of the proposed method has been tested for a number of motors via mathematical modeling, as well as according to the experimental data for a 4AZM-5000/6000 type squirrel-cage rotor induction motor with 5000 kW rated power and 6 kV stator voltage. The values of input resistances obtained experimentally and according to the designed equivalent circuit differ by no more than 5%, which makes it possible to recommend the developed method to be used in practice.

articleTitle: Self-Contained Power Station Based on Asynchronous Electrical Generator with Short Circuit Rotor Winding and Low Power Frequency Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers the construction of a self-contained power station (SCPS), based on an asynchronous generator with a short-circuited rotor and a low-power voltage inverter that provides high-quality output voltage under various loads, including significantly non-symmetrical and nonlinear ones, at a relatively low price and increased reliability. The block-diagrams of the SCPS and its control system without a speed sensor on the generator shaft are presented, as well as the results of modeling in symmetric and asymmetric operating modes, including the mode of blocking power switches of the voltage inverter. SCPS provides an error of output voltage stabilization of no more than 0.5% at maximum load asymmetry, correction of output voltage asymmetry using an original search compensation algorithm, reliable protection against overloads, short circuits and overvoltage using power switches blocking mode of the inverter. In blocking the inverter state SCPS smoothly moves to the mode of an unstable voltage source when the load is within the nominal and to the mode of maintaining the output current at an acceptable level during short circuits and overloads.
